description: Manage (Enable/Disable) RHSM repositories to the Red Hat Subscription Management entitlement platform using the subscription-manager command.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The ID of repositories to enable. To operate on several repositories this can accept a comma separated list or a YAML list.

parameters.name: purge
parameters.description: Disable all currently enabled repositories that are not not specified in name. Only set this to true if passing in a list of repositories to the name field. Using this with loop is likely not to have the desired result. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: If state is equal to present or disabled, indicates the desired repository state. In community.general 10.0.0 the states present and absent have been removed. Please use enabled and disabled instead. Choices: "enabled" ← (default) "disabled"

examples:
- name: Enable a RHSM repository
  community.general.rhsm_repository:
    name: rhel-7-server-rpms

- name: Disable all RHSM repositories
  community.general.rhsm_repository:
    name: '*'
    state: disabled

- name: Enable all repositories starting with rhel-6-server
  community.general.rhsm_repository:
    name: rhel-6-server*
    state: enabled

- name: Disable all repositories except rhel-7-server-rpms
  community.general.rhsm_repository:
    name: rhel-7-server-rpms
    purge: true

return_values.name: repositories
return_values.description: The list of RHSM repositories with their states. When this module is used to change the repository states, this list contains the updated states after the changes. Returned: success
